name: @openrf/mcp
description: Claude Code MCP server for OpenReef — search and submit knowledge entries

scripts.build: tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs';const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(f,0o755);"
